repos.name: shadcn/improve
repos.description: Use your most capable model to audit your codebase and write plans for cheaper models to execute.
repos.one_liner: An AI-driven codebase auditing and task-planning framework designed to optimize LLM workflows.
bullets: Utilizes high-capability LLMs to perform deep code analysis and generate structured execution plans.
Implements a tiered model strategy to delegate complex reasoning to expensive models and routine tasks to cheaper ones.
Focuses on developer productivity by automating code reviews and refactoring roadmaps.
Integrates directly into existing development workflows to reduce technical debt.

repos.name: homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp
repos.description: The Unofficial and Awesome Home Assistant MCP Server
repos.one_liner: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that bridges Home Assistant with AI agents.
bullets: Built in Python to expose Home Assistant entities and services to LLM-based agents.
Enables agentic control over smart home infrastructure via standardized MCP interfaces.
Allows AI models to query state, trigger automations, and interact with IoT devices securely.
Serves as a critical infrastructure layer for building autonomous home-automation agents.

repos.name: garrytan/gbrain
repos.one_liner: An opinionated agentic framework designed for building sophisticated AI-driven reasoning brains.
bullets: TypeScript-based architecture optimized for modular agent development.
Focuses on 'agentic' workflows where the system manages context, memory, and tool-use autonomously.
Provides a structured approach to building AI assistants that can handle complex, multi-step tasks.
Highly relevant for professionals building custom AI agents for business or research automation.

repos.name: Dodaios/ste80-humanizer
repos.description: STE80 Humanizer: agent skill that removes AI tells and rewrites text 80% of the way to ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English), the method Andrej Karpathy shared.
repos.one_liner: An AI agent skill that rewrites text to conform to Simplified Technical English (STE) standards.
bullets: Python-based agentic tool designed to strip 'AI-tells' from generated content.
Implements the ASD-STE100 standard to improve clarity, readability, and technical precision.
Useful for fintech and technical documentation where precise, unambiguous communication is required.
Reduces the cognitive load for readers by enforcing strict vocabulary and grammatical constraints.
repos.img_alt: Simplified Technical English: overview. Document structure, anatomy of STE sentences, verb forms, dictionary entries, writing rule limits and history.

repos.name: jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm
repos.description: Run your own Switch games natively on iPhone, iPad and Mac: game code rewritten to ARM64, graphics direct to Metal, one app for the whole library. Bring your own games and keys. 把你自己的 Switch 游戏原生带到 iPhone / iPad / Mac。
repos.one_liner: A high-performance emulator/recompiler that runs Switch games natively on Apple Silicon via Metal.
bullets: C# codebase that recompiles game logic to ARM64 for native execution on iOS and macOS.
Utilizes Metal API for direct, low-latency graphics rendering on Apple hardware.
Represents a significant engineering feat in cross-platform infrastructure and binary translation.
Demonstrates advanced optimization techniques applicable to high-performance computing and emulation.
